historical_commentary.text: This reference table reflects the complex networking landscape of 1998, when 4D had to support both AppleTalk (Mac-native) and TCP/IP across Mac OS and Windows platforms. The network component architecture described here has been entirely replaced — modern 4D uses TCP/IP exclusively, and AppleTalk support was dropped long ago as Apple itself deprecated the protocol. The note is a useful historical reference for understanding the cross-platform networking challenges of this era.
related_updates: AppleTalk support has been completely removed from both macOS and 4D; TCP/IP is the sole networking protocol
4D's client/server networking layer has been rewritten multiple times; modern 4D Server uses a proprietary TCP-based protocol
